title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 18, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $3,500.00 to
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 18, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $3,500.00 to
  support Harbor Area’s, Harbor Helping Badge,as set forth.  [BPC #26-364]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and ACCEPT the donation.
summary: The Police Commission is asked to accept a $3,500 donation to support the Harbor Area's Harbor Helping Badge effort.
